dialogues.speaker: Read
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis walks among us, and Liyue is secure. To mark the work of our forebears, he <color=#00E1FFFF>left here five seals, setting them within pavilions</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Read
dialogues.text: You who come thereafter must retrace ancients' path and acknowledge their work, and thus you shall obtain their treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The seal over here is probably the thing this tablet is talking about... Looks like we need to use <color=#00E1FFFF>Geo</color> to activate it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: According to this tablet, there should be a total of five seals. Let's have a good look around!
